description: P(LLM wrote it) for one message: its text (element message) and, per patch it carries, the commit message and the code. Each element: p_llm, model_version, model_quality, heldout_auc, computed_at; null p_llm with a reason when not scored (never 0) or when the model's heldout_auc is below 0.6. At most 3 patches per message; mail received before 2022-11-30 is 0 by rule, with one commit_message and one code element however many patches it carries. Weak estimates, not verdicts: read the caveat.
name: llm_estimate
